The web component is the vehicle-detail 'Recent Charges' GlassPanel (p-6) with a header row (neon-green BatteryCharging icon + bold 'Recent Charges' title + a muted 'View all ›' react-router Link to /charging) and either a compact paginated 5-column DataTable of ChargingSession rows (Date, Energy, Duration, Cost, Battery) or an icon+message EmptyState when sessions is empty/undefined. Native port uses RN primitives + native GlassPanel/AppText/theme tokens + a local native-safe DataTable/EmptyState. No DOM element, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide DOM SVG, framer-motion, or old web @/components import appears in the output.

L1 `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'` -> React Native has no DOM anchor / browser-history router, so the 'View all' link becomes a Pressable (accessibilityRole='link') whose press is delegated to an optional onNavigate(to) bridge prop (the QuickNav / HistoryListRow precedent); the `/charging` path is preserved verbatim, and without a bridge a press is an explicit no-op. The web hover:text-neon-green colour shift has no native equivalent and is replaced by a pressed-opacity feedback.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> inline native-safe `useNativeTranslation()` returning `t(key, fallback) = fallback` (no native i18next runtime); all 8 i18n keys + English defaults preserved verbatim (common.recentCharges, common.viewAll, common.date, common.energy, common.duration, common.cost, common.battery, common.noCharges).

L3 `import { BatteryCharging, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react'` -> semantic glyph stand-ins: ICON_BATTERY_CHARGING '\uD83D\uDD0B' 🔋 (the sibling ChargingTelemetrySection / QuickNav convention) and GLYPH_CHEVRON_RIGHT '\u203A' › (the QuickNav / Pagination convention). Used in the title row, the 'View all' affordance, the pager next-button, and the empty-state icon.
